card.name: Digits inside ISBN, ISSN and copyright years
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 8, 0 or 9) in the middle of a number string in a citation, such as an ISBN or ISSN, or the 9 in a copyright year range like 1995-2012.

modes.label: ISBN/ISSN digits
modes.description: A digit partway through an ISBN or ISSN number in a reference or citation.
modes.example: Encyclopedia of World Conflict. United States: ABC-CLIO. p. 430. ISBN 978-1-59<<8>>84-429-0

modes.label: Copyright year
modes.description: The 9 in a 199x year at the start of a copyright range like © 1995-2012.

card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle of a book or journal number or a copyright year range.
